description: This file contains functions for processing and converting Markdown content into Slack-compatible markdown format, including escaping special characters, handling links, and chunking output within size limits.

methods.name: escapeSlackMrkdwnSegment
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a text segment for Slack markdown.

methods.name: isAllowedSlackAngleToken
methods.description: Checks if a Slack angle-bracket token is an allowed mention or link.

methods.name: escapeSlackMrkdwnContent
methods.description: Escapes content for Slack markdown, handling angle-bracket tokens appropriately.

methods.name: escapeSlackMrkdwnText
methods.description: Escapes entire markdown text for Slack, preserving blockquotes.

methods.name: buildSlackLink
methods.description: Builds Slack markdown link syntax from a MarkdownLinkSpan and label.

methods.name: buildSlackRenderOptions
methods.description: Constructs rendering options for markdown to Slack markdown conversion.

methods.name: markdownToSlackMrkdwn
methods.description: Converts Markdown string to Slack markdown format.

methods.name: normalizeSlackOutboundText
methods.description: Normalizes markdown text for Slack outbound messages.

methods.name: markdownToSlackMrkdwnChunks
methods.description: Splits markdown into chunks suitable for Slack messages within size limits.
